source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler) -enc UTF-8, raw and -layout modes; pages rendered with pdfplumber to check notation
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Printed: Maximum marks 70, three hours plus 15 minutes reading time; '7 printed pages and 1 blank page' (the PDF contains the 7 printed pages only); footer code '1220-862A' on every page (recorded as paperCode). No lettered sections are printed: Question 1 (20 marks: (a) 4×1 fill in the blanks, (b) 4×1 MCQ, (c) 4×1 matching, (d) 4×2 short answers), Questions 2-8 (2 marks each), 9-15 (3 marks each), 16-18 (5 marks each). Internal choice (OR) in Questions 2, 7, 9, 13, 16, 17 and 18, entered as (a)/(b) alternatives sharing a choiceGroup. The matching item 1(c) is split into its four 1-mark items, each repeating the column-B list. Where one bracket covers independent sub-parts that divide evenly (Questions 3, 4, 5, 11, 12, 15) they are split with an assumed even mark split (marksSource SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). The text layer flattens subscripts, superscripts and charges and scrambles reaction schemes and electrode-potential notation; these were rebuilt in Unicode from the rendered pages and flagged per question. The 2020 syllabus included topics (solid state, surface chemistry, metallurgy, p-block elements, polymers, chemistry in everyday life) that have no chapter in the current ISC list; those questions have chapter null.
